---
title: "Part 2 — The Production"
---

Part 2 completes the forward construction: from scenes, to an audio-first
screenplay, to a rendered audio artifact, and finally to engineering-style
review.

Having reverse-engineered the Crossplane restaurant in Part 1, you now apply the
process in the **forward** direction and prepare your own project for the
culminating lab.

## Lessons

- [1. Design the Scenes](05-design-the-scenes/index.qmd) — break the
  explanation into scenes with purpose and learning outcome. Produce `scenes.md`.
- [2. Write the Audio Screenplay](06-write-the-audio-screenplay/index.qmd) —
  the audio-first, scene-oriented intermediate representation. Produce
  `screenplay.md`.
- [3. Produce with Generative AI](07-produce-with-generative-ai/index.qmd) —
  render the screenplay to audio. Produce `production.md` and `audio-play.mp3`.
- [4. Listen Like an Engineer](08-listen-like-an-engineer/index.qmd) —
  review, evaluate, and iterate. Produce `evaluation.md`.

Each lesson in this course follows the same page layout — see the
[course overview](../index.qmd) for the full pattern.
